title: Train Rides for Sleep
description: Long train journeys through Germany, England, and America. Rhythmic carriage sounds, passing landscapes, and the gentle rocking of the tracks. From ICE high-speed to Amtrak cross-country.
concept: Train rides are perfect sleep content. The rhythmic clicking of wheels on tracks, the gentle swaying, the world passing by outside the window. Each video simulates a multi-hour train journey with ambient sounds, near-static visuals, and optional voice announcements.

audio_style.primary: train ambient loop (wheel rhythm, wind, track joints)
audio_style.visual: train window view OR dark cabin interior OR black screen

routes.description: Germany's flagship high-speed line. Flat farmland, small towns, the Elbe river crossing. Mostly above-ground with tunnels near cities.
scenes: Wolfsburg area (VW factory visible from train)

routes.description: Bavarian countryside. Rolling hills, medieval towns, the Franconian lakes district. Short but scenic.
The Channel Tunnel crossing. Green English farmland, the white cliffs of Dover, the 50km underwater tunnel, then French countryside into Paris.
scenes: Approaching Paris (suburban, then Gare du Nord)

routes.description: The East Coast Main Line. London commuter belt, Yorkshire moors, Durham castle, Newcastle, the Scottish border, then Edinburgh.
scenes: Durham castle and cathedral (on hill above river)

routes.description: One of America's most beautiful train rides. The Bay Area, Central Valley agriculture, the Pacific coast at San Luis Obispo, then into LA.
scenes: Pacific Ocean visible (San Luis Obispo to Santa Barbara)

routes.description: Puget Sound, the Olympic Mountains, the Columbia River, and the lush Pacific Northwest. Short and stunning.
scenes: Olympic Mountains visible across the sound

routes.description: The bullet train. Urban Tokyo, then Mount Fuji visible, the Japanese Alps, then Osaka. Iconic.
scenes: Mount Fuji visible (30min window, weather permitting)
